items.name: Carl’s Leather Jacket
items.locator: Carl Floor 1, PDF p. 2, Gear Slots: Torso
items.tldr: Light armor made from a heavy jacket.
items.details: Light armor. AC 11 + Dexterity modifier, with no Dexterity cap, Strength minimum, or Stealth disadvantage. Requires Light Armor training. Weight 10 lb. Don or doff in 1 minute.
items.creative: Use the jacket as part of a mundane crawler disguise.
items.changes: Uses the D&D 2024 Leather Armor profile in place of CarlRPG Damage Resistance 1.
items.verification_scope: The cited excerpt, public RPG sheet or licensed product listing confirms the item identity and appearance. D&D rules and gp estimates are project-authored.

items.name: Carl’s Boxer Shorts
items.locator: Carl Floor 1, PDF p. 2, Gear Slots: Legs
items.tldr: Ordinary starting clothes.
items.details: Mundane clothing. Weight 1 lb. Grants no Armor Class, armor training benefit, or magic. Fits one creature of the wearer’s size.
items.creative: Use the conspicuous pattern as a signal when allies are separated.
items.changes: Keeps the starting shorts separate from the later enchanted BigBoi item.
items.verification_scope: The cited excerpt, public RPG sheet or licensed product listing confirms the item identity and appearance. D&D rules and gp estimates are project-authored.

items.locator: Carl Floor 1, PDF p. 2, Gear Slots: Feet
items.tldr: Borrowed pink sandals.
items.details: Mundane footwear, 1 lb per pair. They provide ordinary foot covering and grant no bonus to AC, Speed, checks, or saving throws.
items.creative: Leave the bright shoes in plain sight as a false trail.

items.locator: Princess Donut Floor 1, PDF p. 4, Gear Slots: Accessories
items.tldr: Plain collar for a Tiny quadruped.
items.details: Mundane collar that fits a Tiny quadruped. It weighs less than 1 lb and has no armor or magic properties. An attached identification tag can be read within reach.

items.name: Crawler Healing Potion
items.locator: Carl and Princess Donut Floor 1, PDF pp. 2, 4, Hotlist
items.tldr: Restores 2d4 + 2 Hit Points.
items.details: As a Bonus Action, drink this potion or administer it to one creature within 5 feet. The drinker regains 2d4 + 2 Hit Points. The potion is consumed.
items.creative: Pass the potion to the party member most likely to reach an isolated ally.
items.changes: Uses the 2024 Potion of Healing benchmark in place of CarlRPG Health Bar slots.
items.verification_scope: The cited excerpt, public RPG sheet or licensed product listing confirms the item identity and appearance. D&D rules and gp estimates are project-authored.

items.name: Crawler Mana Potion
items.locator: Princess Donut Floor 1, PDF p. 4, Hotlist
items.tldr: Restores one expended spell slot of level 2 or lower.
items.details: As a Bonus Action, drink the potion and choose one of your expended level 1 or 2 spell slots. You regain that slot. A creature can regain a slot from this potion once per Long Rest. The potion is consumed.
items.creative: Save a slot for a utility spell that solves an obstacle without a fight.
items.changes: Replaces full CarlRPG mana recovery with one low-level spell slot and a per-creature limit.
items.verification_scope: The cited excerpt, public RPG sheet or licensed product listing confirms the item identity and appearance. D&D rules and gp estimates are project-authored.

items.name: Goblin Murder Dozer
items.locator: Printed pp. 19, 30–31; PDF pp. 32, 43–44
items.tldr: Small crewed dungeon vehicle with a charge and volatile ward.
items.details: Large land vehicle, AC 15, 45 HP, Speed 40 feet, one crew, one passenger. The driver takes the Utilize action to move it up to its Speed. Once during that movement, after traveling 15 feet straight, one creature in its path makes a DC 14 Dexterity save. It takes 3d8 Bludgeoning damage and falls Prone on a failure or takes half damage and stays standing on a success. At 0 HP the vehicle stops. At the end of the next round its dungeon ward ruptures; creatures within 10 feet make a DC 14 Dexterity save, taking 3d6 Force damage on a failure or half on a success. Total Cover blocks the burst.
items.creative: Use the intact shell as cover while moving through a wide corridor.
items.changes: Bounds an encounter vehicle as a crewed object and converts the original magical blast into a delayed Force area.
items.verification_scope: The cited excerpt, public RPG sheet or licensed product listing confirms the item identity and appearance. D&D rules and gp estimates are project-authored.

items.name: Enchanted BigBoi Boxers
items.locator: Book 1, dedicated BigBoi Boxers entry
items.tldr: Wearable cloth with a limited defensive shell.
items.details: These clothes grant no Armor Class formula. While wearing them without armor, when you take damage you can use a Reaction to reduce that damage by 2d8 + your Proficiency Bonus. You can use this reaction twice and regain both uses when you finish a Long Rest.
items.creative: Use the shell to cross a hazardous doorway and secure a route for allies.
items.changes: Converts the reported Protective Shell into limited damage reduction. The mundane boxer shorts remain a separate item.

items.name: Enchanted War Gauntlet of the Exalted Grull
items.locator: Book 1, dedicated Grull gauntlet entry
items.tldr: An enchanted striking fist with a knockback charge.
items.details: Simple melee weapon, one hand, 5-foot reach, 1d6 + Strength modifier Bludgeoning damage, 4 lb. Add Strength modifier and your Proficiency Bonus if proficient to the attack roll. Mastery: Sap. You gain +1 to attack and damage rolls with it. Once per turn when you hit a Large or smaller creature, you can expend 1 charge to force a DC 14 Strength save. On a failure you push it up to 10 feet straight away. It has 3 charges and regains all charges at dawn. The hand must be empty when you attack.
items.creative: Push a movable obstruction toward a waiting ally instead of away from the group.
items.changes: Treats the formed gauntlet as a mace-profile weapon so its power works across classes. Converts amplified Pugilism into a limited shove.

items.name: Enchanted Shuriken of Bloodlust
items.locator: Book 1, dedicated Bloodlust Shuriken entry
items.tldr: Thrown star that deals extra damage to a wounded target.
items.details: Simple melee weapon with Finesse, Light, and Thrown (20/60 feet), Nick mastery, and 5-foot reach. A hit deals 1d4 + the chosen Strength or Dexterity modifier Piercing damage. Add that modifier and Proficiency Bonus if proficient to the attack roll. When it hits a Bloodied creature after being thrown, add 1d4 Necrotic damage. After any thrown attack, this star becomes nonmagical. A star weighs 1 lb and the listed price buys one star.
items.creative: Keep one star in reserve for a foe that escapes behind the front line.
items.changes: Uses a dagger’s D&D profile and makes the source’s expendable volley a one-throw enchantment.

items.name: Toad Cudgel
items.locator: Book 1, dedicated Toad Cudgel entry
items.tldr: A heavy cudgel used with both hands.
items.details: Simple melee weapon, 5-foot reach, Two-Handed, Push mastery, 10 lb. A hit deals 1d8 + Strength modifier Bludgeoning damage. Add your Strength modifier and Proficiency Bonus if proficient to the attack roll.
items.creative: Use the broad end to press a large floor switch from the edge.
items.changes: Uses the 2024 Greatclub rules as the cudgel’s combat profile.

items.name: Enchanted Trollskin Shirt of Pummeling
items.locator: Book 1, dedicated Trollskin Shirt entry
items.tldr: Hide armor with brief recovery and a bruiser’s opening.
items.details: Medium armor. AC 12 + Dexterity modifier (maximum +2), no Strength minimum or Stealth disadvantage, 12 lb. Requires Medium Armor training. Don in 5 minutes, doff in 1 minute. While wearing it, once per Long Rest use a Bonus Action to regain 2d6 + your Proficiency Bonus Hit Points. Once each turn on a hit with a damaging Unarmed Strike, you may reroll one damage die from that strike and must use the new roll.
items.creative: Keep the recovery in reserve before entering a cramped room where retreat is hard.
items.changes: Uses 2024 Hide Armor and replaces troll regeneration and Pugilism ranks with bounded benefits.

items.name: Enchanted Nightgaunt Cloak of Stoutness
items.locator: Book 1, dedicated Nightgaunt Cloak entry
items.tldr: A cloak that protects its wearer from poison.
items.details: While wearing this cloak, you have Resistance to Poison damage and Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Poisoned condition. Once per Long Rest, you can use a Bonus Action to end the Poisoned condition on yourself. Weight 2 lb.
items.creative: Take point while scouting a passage filled with poisonous fumes.
items.changes: Converts the reported poison protection into Resistance and a limited cleanse.

items.name: Enchanted Toe Ring of the Splatter Skunk
items.locator: Book 1, dedicated Splatter Skunk toe ring entry
items.tldr: A toe ring that adds force to an unarmed strike.
items.details: While wearing the ring, after you hit a creature with a damaging Unarmed Strike, you can deal an extra 1d6 Bludgeoning damage. You can do this a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus and regain all uses when you finish a Long Rest.
items.creative: Save a use for a round when an ally needs you to break an enemy’s Concentration.

items.name: Enchanted Spiked Kneepads of the Shade Gnoll Riot Forces
items.locator: Book 1, dedicated Shade Gnoll Kneepads entry
items.tldr: Spiked pads that help the wearer brace in a struggle.
items.details: While wearing the pair, you have Advantage on a check or saving throw you make to avoid being moved or knocked Prone. Once per Short or Long Rest when you hit a creature within 5 feet with a damaging Unarmed Strike, you can change that strike’s damage to Piercing and add 1d4 to it. Weight 2 lb per pair.
items.creative: Brace at a doorway when enemies are trying to shove the party out.
items.changes: Gives the pads an original grappling and bracing role without creating an armor slot.

evidence.locator: Book 1, dedicated Shade Gnoll Kneepads entry

items.name: Enchanted Crown of the Sepsis Whore
items.locator: Book 1, dedicated Enchanted Crown entry
items.tldr: A royal crown with an infectious strike and a succession curse.
items.details: While wearing the crown, you have Advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks to make a first impression. Once per turn on a hit with an attack roll, expend a charge to force a DC 16 Constitution save. Failure: 2d6 Poison damage and the target is Poisoned until the end of its next turn. Success: half damage. The crown has 3 charges and regains all at dawn. Curse: on attunement you become eligible for a claim to the Blood Sultanate. You cannot voluntarily end attunement. Remove Curse breaks attunement and releases you from the magical claim.
items.creative: Have an ally negotiate with the rival heirs while you investigate the legitimacy of the claim.
items.changes: Converts the reported infection chance, social skill and succession curse into limited uses and a standard curse exit.

items.name: Enchanted Fur Brush of the Ecclesiastic
items.locator: Book 1, dedicated Ecclesiastic Fur Brush entry
items.tldr: A grooming tool that helps a beast recover before a performance.
items.details: Spend 1 minute brushing one willing Beast or furred creature within reach. For 1 hour, it has 1d6 Temporary Hit Points and Advantage on its next Charisma (Performance) check. Once used, the brush cannot be used again until dawn.
items.creative: Brush a nervous animal before presenting it to a suspicious handler.
items.changes: Creates a bounded tabletop grooming benefit; later enhanced variants need separate source review.

evidence.locator: Book 1, dedicated Ecclesiastic Fur Brush entry

items.name: Enhanced Pet Biscuit
items.locator: Book 1, dedicated Enhanced Pet Biscuit entry
items.tldr: A rare treat for a willing ordinary animal.
items.details: As a Magic action, feed the biscuit to one willing Beast within 5 feet whose Intelligence is 3 or lower. It is consumed. The Beast gains Intelligence 10 and can speak one language you know. It is Charmed by you for up to 30 days; the charm ends if you or your allies harm it, and the creature decides its own conduct. This item never grants a character level, permanent obedience, or an extra turn.
items.creative: Awaken a willing animal witness that can describe what it saw.
items.changes: Uses an Awaken-style effect for the reported transformation. The character’s exceptional crawler status remains a story decision.

evidence.locator: Book 1, dedicated Enhanced Pet Biscuit entry

items.name: Enchanted Fae Scale Quadruped Crupper of the Fleet
items.locator: Book 1, dedicated Donut’s crupper entry
items.tldr: Quadruped tack for quick footing.
items.details: A willing quadruped that can wear the crupper gains a 5-foot bonus to its Speed. Once per Short or Long Rest, when it takes the Dash action it ignores nonmagical Difficult Terrain until the end of that turn. The effect ends if the tack is removed. The crupper grants no armor bonus.
items.creative: Equip a willing messenger animal before a crossing through shallow scree.
items.changes: Replaces the reported Dexterity increase with speed and movement benefits.

items.name: Cheat Code Potion
items.locator: Printed p. 23; PDF p. 34, Pugilism reference; Book 4 printed p. 28
items.tldr: A short-lived potion that temporarily sharpens a random skill.
items.details: As a Bonus Action, drink it and roll 1d6 to determine a skill: 1 Athletics, 2 Acrobatics, 3 Arcana, 4 Investigation, 5 Perception, 6 Persuasion. For 1 hour you have Advantage on checks using that skill. The potion expires 24 hours after you acquire it.
items.creative: Drink it before a challenge that permits more than one approach.
items.changes: Replaces the LitRPG skill rank change with an hour of Advantage and models the source’s short shelf life.

items.name: Princess Donut’s Dexterity Bracelet
items.locator: Printed p. 27; PDF p. 38, Donut’s equipment modifier
items.tldr: A bracelet that helps its wearer act first and move cleanly.
items.details: While wearing the bracelet, you gain a +1 bonus to Initiative rolls. When you fail a Dexterity (Acrobatics) check, you can reroll it once and use the new roll. You regain the use at dawn.
items.creative: Put it on before crossing a bridge in a high wind.
items.changes: Replaces the source’s flat Dexterity score modifier with a small initiative bonus and a limited skill reroll.

items.name: Confusing Fog Scroll
items.locator: Printed p. 27; PDF p. 40, Silver Quest Box
items.tldr: Creates a short-lived cloud that obscures vision and hinders movement.
items.details: As a Magic action, read this scroll to create a 15-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point you can see within 60 feet. For up to 1 minute with Concentration, the area is Heavily Obscured and counts as Difficult Terrain for creatures other than you. A strong wind disperses the cloud. The scroll is consumed; anyone who can read a language can activate it.
items.creative: Break line of sight while wounded allies withdraw along a known path.
items.changes: Uses a bounded Fog Cloud variant in place of the dungeon’s Confusing Fog effect.
items.verification_scope: The cited excerpt, public RPG sheet or licensed product listing confirms the item identity and appearance. D&D rules and gp estimates are project-authored.

items.name: Crawler Heal Scroll
items.locator: Printed p. 27; PDF p. 40, Silver Quest Box
items.tldr: Heals a creature you touch.
items.details: As a Magic action, read the scroll and touch one creature. It regains 2d8 + 3 Hit Points. The scroll is consumed. Anyone who can read a language can use it. The effect uses a fixed level-1 Cure Wounds benchmark.
items.creative: Keep it with a lookout who can reach the party’s healer if they fall.
items.changes: Preserves the quick healing of another creature and names the low-level D&D benchmark to distinguish it from the level-6 spell Heal.
items.verification_scope: The cited excerpt, public RPG sheet or licensed product listing confirms the item identity and appearance. D&D rules and gp estimates are project-authored.

items.name: Enchanted Necklace of the Haute Bourgeoisie
items.locator: Printed p. 28; PDF p. 41, Platinum Tyrant’s Box
items.tldr: A chartered settlement necklace that records a claim and grants a talon strike.
items.details: The necklace begins with one settlement gem. It conveys no ownership without a recognized charter. While attuned, you have Advantage on Intelligence checks about the represented settlement. Once per Long Rest as a Magic action, choose one creature you can see within 30 feet. It makes a DC 15 Dexterity save, taking 3d6 Slashing damage on failure or half on success. If the campaign uses settlement revenues, the DM can authorize a stipend once every 10 days; the necklace creates no money.
items.creative: Use the gem as a credential when negotiating safe passage in the represented settlement.
items.changes: Preserves the settlement gem, ten-day tax cadence and Talon Strike while tying revenue to actual campaign governance.
items.verification_scope: The cited excerpt, public RPG sheet or licensed product listing confirms the item identity and appearance. D&D rules and gp estimates are project-authored.

items.name: Enchanted Tiara of Mana Genita
items.locator: Printed p. 32; PDF p. 45, Donut’s replacement tiara
items.tldr: A tiara that helps the wearer detect creatures and approach Mana Genita’s worshippers.
items.details: While wearing it, you have Advantage on Intelligence (Investigation) checks to locate signs of nearby creatures. Once per Long Rest as a Magic action, learn the direction, but not identity, of each creature within 30 feet that is neither behind Total Cover nor hidden from divination. Followers of Mana Genita recognize the tiara, though their attitudes remain the DM’s decision.
items.creative: Check a side passage before escorting guests into a shrine.
items.changes: Converts the Intelligence bonus and minimap detection into investigation and a short-range magical scan.
items.verification_scope: The cited excerpt, public RPG sheet or licensed product listing confirms the item identity and appearance. D&D rules and gp estimates are project-authored.

items.name: The Dungeon Anarchist’s Cookbook
items.locator: Printed p. 17; PDF p. 28, author of the second edition; Book 3 publisher synopsis
items.tldr: A book of inherited notes for spotting dungeon-system loopholes.
items.details: Spend 10 minutes consulting the book and choose one visible trap, locked barrier, or surveillance effect within 30 feet. The DM reveals one practical limitation or clue about how it works. The next ability check you make to disable, bypass, or conceal yourself from that feature within 1 hour has Advantage. The book can be used twice per dawn. It cannot reveal an effect that the DM rules has no discoverable weakness.
items.creative: Study a surveillance ward before planning a peaceful exit from a monitored hall.
items.changes: Models the inherited advice as a limited investigation resource. It contains no replicable real-world recipes.
items.verification_scope: The cited excerpt, public RPG sheet or licensed product listing confirms the item identity and appearance. D&D rules and gp estimates are project-authored.

items.name: Scroll of Water Breathing
items.locator: Printed p. 23; PDF p. 38, description of the scroll
items.tldr: Lets willing creatures breathe underwater for 24 hours.
items.details: As a Magic action, read the scroll to cast Water Breathing. Choose up to ten willing creatures you can see within 30 feet. They can breathe underwater for 24 hours and retain their normal breathing. The scroll is consumed. Anyone who can read a language can activate it.
items.creative: Let an entire group investigate a submerged chamber on the same outing.
items.changes: Uses the 2024 Water Breathing spell with the adventure’s freely usable scroll model.
items.verification_scope: The cited excerpt, public RPG sheet or licensed product listing confirms the item identity and appearance. D&D rules and gp estimates are project-authored.

items.name: Crawler Invisibility Potion
items.locator: Printed p. 24; PDF p. 39, loot box reward
items.tldr: Makes its drinker Invisible for up to one hour.
items.details: As a Bonus Action, drink the potion. You have the Invisible condition for 1 hour. The effect ends early immediately after you make an attack roll, deal damage, or cast a spell. The potion is consumed.
items.creative: Slip past a sentry to open a gate for the rest of the group.
items.changes: Uses a bounded D&D invisibility duration and explicit termination rather than the dungeon’s potion timer.

items.name: Extinction Sigil Tattoo
items.locator: Printed p. 27; PDF p. 42, Wall Monitor tattoo
items.tldr: A tattoo that calms natural predators of a chosen creature.
items.details: When this tattoo is applied, the DM and recipient identify one specific Beast as the sigil’s reference species. While attuned, the bearer has Advantage on Wisdom (Animal Handling) checks made to calm Beasts that prey on that species. Once per Long Rest as a Magic action, choose one such Beast within 30 feet. It must make a DC 15 Wisdom save. On a failure it cannot attack the bearer for 1 minute; the effect ends if the bearer harms it. The tattoo never forces an animal to obey.
items.creative: Use it to escort livestock past a known predator without fighting it.
items.changes: Maps automatic hostility to Animal Handling and a limited calming effect. The source wall monitor is one possible reference species.
items.verification_scope: The cited excerpt, public RPG sheet or licensed product listing confirms the item identity and appearance. D&D rules and gp estimates are project-authored.

items.name: Pawna’s Tears
items.locator: Printed p. 28; PDF p. 43, Legendary Deity’s Box
items.tldr: A blessing that markedly improves one chosen skill for a day.
items.details: As a Bonus Action, drink the potion and choose a skill. For 24 hours you gain proficiency in it. If you already have proficiency, your Proficiency Bonus is doubled for checks using that skill during the duration. The doubling does not stack with Expertise. Once during the duration, after failing a check with the chosen skill, reroll and use the new result. The potion is consumed.
items.creative: Choose Persuasion before a day of negotiations rather than spending it on one check.
items.changes: Replaces the original freely chosen permanent five-rank increase with a temporary, bounded skill blessing.
items.verification_scope: The cited excerpt, public RPG sheet or licensed product listing confirms the item identity and appearance. D&D rules and gp estimates are project-authored.

items.name: Mana Toast
items.locator: Printed p. 48; PDF p. 59, mana recovery without a potion
items.tldr: A snack that restores a small amount of spellcasting.
items.details: Consume the toast during a Short Rest. At the end of the rest you regain one expended level 1 spell slot. The toast is consumed and a creature can gain this benefit once per Long Rest.
items.creative: Use it while regrouping so your stronger consumables remain available.
items.changes: Converts food-based mana recovery to a level 1 slot and uses a Short Rest to give it a different role from potions.
items.verification_scope: The cited excerpt, public RPG sheet or licensed product listing confirms the item identity and appearance. D&D rules and gp estimates are project-authored.

items.name: Carl’s Doomsday Scenario
items.locator: Printed p. 38; PDF p. 49, account of the contained bomb
items.tldr: A sealed fictional catastrophe for a GM-controlled set piece.
items.details: A creature holding the sealed vessel can use a Magic action to open it and place it in a space within reach. At the end of its next turn the vessel is destroyed and releases magical energy. Each creature within 60 feet makes a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw, taking 20d6 Force damage on a failure or half on a success. Total Cover blocks the effect. Unattended objects in the area take the full damage. The effect is single use. The GM controls when the sealed vessel enters play.
items.creative: Make evacuating bystanders the objective of the encounter before the artifact is opened.
items.changes: Converts the plot-scale weapon into a bounded artifact encounter hazard. No conventional manufacturing or activation method is inferred.
items.verification_scope: The cited excerpt, public RPG sheet or licensed product listing confirms the item identity and appearance. D&D rules and gp estimates are project-authored.

items.name: Cosmic Buff Potion
items.locator: Printed pp. 34, 36; PDF pp. 53, 55, Donut’s random ability buff
items.tldr: Boosts one random ability score for an hour.
items.details: As a Bonus Action, drink it and roll 1d6: 1 Strength, 2 Dexterity, 3 Constitution, 4 Intelligence, 5 Wisdom, 6 Charisma. For 1 hour the result increases by 2, to a maximum of 22. You can benefit from only one Cosmic Buff Potion at a time. The potion is consumed.
items.creative: Drink it before an expedition with multiple kinds of obstacles so any result can matter.
items.changes: Retains the random stat and limits the size and duration to tabletop bounds.
items.verification_scope: The cited excerpt, public RPG sheet or licensed product listing confirms the item identity and appearance. D&D rules and gp estimates are project-authored.

items.name: Potion of Phasing Through Walls
items.locator: Printed pp. 33, 35; PDF pp. 52, 54, phasing potions
items.tldr: Lets you walk briefly through ordinary walls.
items.details: As a Bonus Action, drink the potion. For 1 minute you can move through nonmagical wood, stone, and metal as Difficult Terrain. If you end your turn inside solid matter, you return to the last unoccupied space you occupied and take 2d10 Force damage. Magical barriers, creatures, and lead remain solid to you. The potion is consumed.
items.creative: Scout a blocked corridor and return through the same wall before the effect expires.
items.changes: Retains the described materials and adds standard tabletop movement and an ending-in-matter consequence.

items.name: Enchanted Right Back Atcha Personal Shield
items.locator: Printed p. 47; PDF p. 66, bracer reward
items.tldr: A shield that can catch and reflect a ranged hit.
items.details: Shield, +2 AC while wielded, requires Shield training, 6 lb. Don or doff with the Utilize action. While wielding it, when a ranged weapon or ranged spell attack hits you, you may use your Reaction and expend a charge to gain +4 AC against that attack. If this makes it miss, and the attacker is within 60 feet and visible to you, it must make a DC 16 Dexterity save, taking 3d8 Force damage on a failure or half on a success. The shield has 3 charges and regains all at dawn. It offers no protection from effects requiring a saving throw.
items.creative: Draw the fire of a ranged foe while allies move to cover.
items.changes: Replaces layered percentage checks with one defensive reaction, a bounded return effect, and ordinary shield hand use.
items.verification_scope: The cited excerpt, public RPG sheet or licensed product listing confirms the item identity and appearance. D&D rules and gp estimates are project-authored.

items.name: Tome of Legionnaires of the Damned
items.locator: Printed pp. 38–39; PDF pp. 57–58, Legionnaires of the Damned spell reward
items.tldr: Temporarily animates abandoned arms or armor.
items.details: Once per dawn as a Magic action, choose up to three unattended nonmagical weapons or suits of armor within 30 feet. They animate for up to 1 minute with Concentration. Each is a Small Construct with AC 15, 20 HP, Speed 25 feet, immunity to Poison and Psychic damage, and a melee attack (+7 to hit, reach 5 feet, 1d8 + 3 Force damage). As a Bonus Action, command all to move and attack; they act immediately after your turn and otherwise Dodge. When the effect ends they fall inert. The animation fails on worn or held items.
items.creative: Animate unused equipment to guard a retreat for one minute.
items.changes: Uses a bounded Animate Objects-style stat block and keeps the spell’s equipment requirement.
items.verification_scope: The cited excerpt, public RPG sheet or licensed product listing confirms the item identity and appearance. D&D rules and gp estimates are project-authored.

items.name: Enchanted Prison Tattoo Kit
